author.label: by author, surname first

subject.label: by what it is about
subject.note: Grouped, then whatever order they went back in.

colour.label: by the colour of the spine
colour.note: It looks wonderful and it is useless for finding anything.

size.label: tallest to shortest
size.note: Which is how a shelf stops sagging, whatever anyone says about it.

acquired.label: in the order they arrived
acquired.note: Oldest at the left. A life, read left to right.

none.label: however they went back
none.note: There is no order. Putting one back wrong is impossible.

shelves.note: She works in an archive and the shelf knows it. There is a card index in a shoebox underneath.
Alphabetical by surname, because anything else is an opinion and he does not hold with those.
A gradient, red round to violet. She knows it is useless. She can find anything anyway.
Tallest at the left, the way prints file. Everything in this flat is filed like a photograph.
By what it is about, and the music sits together at the end where she can reach it from the stool.
Alphabetical, and the articles are ignored, and there was an argument about that.
In the order they came to him. He can tell you who gave him each one and what year it was.
However they went back. He would like it on record that this is also a system.
